scope: Two Stage 2B-D seeds through step 1000; DEV-1, fixed DEV-2 subsample, and frozen loss-calibration slice only

initialization.construction: rebuild from the signed P3.5 Arm-S endpoint under seed 20260819 plus seed before Stage 2B module construction

dev1.role: amplitude, component, and generative K-sweep discrete reads

dev2_subsample.selection: proportional battery-stratified allocation with minimum one per represented battery, then lowest stable hash

heldout_training_slice.role: per-loop CE and forward-KL at initialization and step 1000

onset_trajectory.claim_boundary: training telemetry is not a checkpointed causal or task-score trajectory; no interpolation, replay, or onset-timing claim

amplitude_response.zero_write_gate: step-1000 and initialization predictions must be bit-identical at gamma 0

component_attribution.implementation_note: inherited_flow_off disables the inherited SharedResidualFlow update while preserving final bridge execution; disabling the final bridge is already the zero-write plumbing control and is scientifically non-discriminating

correction_field_clusterability.loss: mean answer-bearing-token cross entropy on the frozen gold/teacher target
correction_field_clusterability.correction_direction: negative gradient at the bridge write-path output, averaged across active writable sequence positions and L2-normalized per row

clustering.selection: maximum silhouette with the same maximum applied inside every null replicate
clustering.rotation_null: independent isotropic row rotations preserving row norms

cluster_battery_mi.estimator: mutual information in nats plus normalization by battery entropy

correction_field_clusterability.mean_field_confirmation: cosine between the mean normalized step-1000 loop-4 writeback direction and the mean normalized initialization loop-4 correction direction
correction_field_clusterability.null_scope_note: a shared orthogonal rotation preserves Gram geometry exactly and is a sanity control, not a clusterability null

decision_mapping.h_b_magnitude: a gamma below 0.05 beats the registered initialization on DEV-1; successor is margin-indexed radius control and trainable gate temperature
decision_mapping.h_c_constitutive: constitutive_off restores materially more capability than inherited_flow_off; successor replaces the constitutive constructor with a gated additive innovation
decision_mapping.h_a_attractor: task-signal correlation collapses, recurrent states converge across questions, and heldout CE/KL improves or stays flat while task margins fall; every successor requires an explicit task-preservation anchor

claim_boundaries: No optimizer construction or parameter update.
No checkpoint selection from diagnostic cells.
The router-geometry proposal is successor-design context and is not tested by this autopsy.
The M2 recipe remains closed as built regardless of the autopsy result.
Arm 6 permits backward passes only to read intermediate gradients; no optimizer is constructed and no parameter is mutated.

retention_incident.root_cause: RETAIN_STEPS was declared but not wired to the save path; resume.pt was overwritten every 20 steps
retention_incident.law: every look receipt verifies existence and SHA-256 of every retention artifact due by that step; missing is stop-the-line
retention_incident.preflight: a dry run crosses one retained step and asserts the named durable checkpoint exists
